children: ADX Energy Ltd. commenced an approximately eight-week Austrian well work program targeting 95–115 BOEPD of incremental production across Vienna Basin fields and Phase 2 testing at HOCH-1. The 100 BOEPD headline target is approximate; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Program targets approx. 100 BOEPD incremental output
Potential production growth is material, but the release describes expected results, not achieved output.
GA-093 targets 50–60 BOEPD of gas output
The largest quantified production target could lift cash flow; delivery depends on successful recompletion.
GA-072A targets approx. 15 BOEPD incremental output
Pump replacement offers a smaller expected production increase; results remain unconfirmed.
GA-087 targets 30–40 BOPD of oil output
This adds a separate expected production contribution, subject to completion work.
HOCH-1 Phase 1 flow: 3.15 MMCFPD from 4 reservoirs
This is a prior test result, not the outcome of the upcoming Phase 2 test.

This is an operational update following HOCH-1 Phase 1 testing, rather than confirmation of new production. The next catalyst is reported well-work and Phase 2 test results, which ADX says it will provide as they become available.
